name: Gutter cleaning
summary: Gutter cleaning visits priced per run from linear feet, stories, pitch, guards, debris and downspouts.

items.label: Front and sides, 1 story, open, leaves
items.source: 8 min per 10 lf baseline (index.html); 1-story/low/open/leaves factors 1.0 (STORY/PITCH/GUARD/DEBRIS_PRESETS); run from STARTING_RUNS

items.label: Rear two-story, moderate pitch
items.source: 8 min per 10 lf x 2-story 1.6 x moderate pitch 1.15 (STORY/PITCH_PRESETS); 40 lf run from STARTING_RUNS

items.label: Garage with screens, mixed debris
items.source: 8 min per 10 lf x screens 1.5 x mixed debris 1.2 (GUARD/DEBRIS_PRESETS); 30 lf run from STARTING_RUNS

items.label: Flush downspouts, 1 story
items.source: 8 min per downspout (index.html) x 1-story 1.0; 3 + 1 downspouts on the 1-story runs in STARTING_RUNS

items.label: Flush downspout, 2 story
items.source: 8 min per downspout x 2-story factor 1.6 (calc.mjs applies story factor to downspouts); 1 downspout in STARTING_RUNS

specialistModels: Multiplies minutes per foot by story, pitch, guard and debris factors per run, applies a $125 minimum stop charge, and prices a 2-visit seasonal contract.
